Hello from Chapel Hill ✦

Hi, I'm Yuqi.

At UNC Chapel Hill, I move between data science and media, following the small clues that lead to bigger stories. A baseball swing, a survey response, a piece of writing, or a conversation can each open a new way of seeing the world.

Data analysis · Statistical modeling · Visual storytelling

About Me

I am pursuing a B.S. in Data Science and a B.A. in Media and Journalism at UNC Chapel Hill, with a minor in Statistics & Analytics. My interests include predictive modeling, data visualization, sports analytics, social media simulation, and mental health.

Outside of class: café discoveries, cooking, traveling, handball, and my ongoing quest to make world's best matcha latte. 🍵

I love both the quiet work of finding a pattern and the creative work of giving it meaning. Data teaches me how to ask sharper questions, while media helps me bring the answers into conversation. These are two sides of the same curiosity. Choose a side to explore where each has taken me.

Carolina Data Challenge · Music Listening Profiles

Python · PCA · K-means clustering · Survey analysis

  • Analyzed 567 responses from the Music & Mental Health survey to explore how music habits form distinct listener profiles and relate to self-reported well-being.
  • Encoded 23 listening features, used PCA to reduce them to 18 components retaining 91.9% of variance, and applied K-means to describe six exploratory listener profiles.
  • Compared the profiles on self-reported mental health measures. Depression scores differed overall across profiles, but no individual pair remained significant after correction for multiple comparisons; the observational analysis does not establish causation.
